confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain and varies widely by season and district, and July is peak beach season. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local price relationship to draft beer because direct knowledge is weaker. Local-currency prices were converted at an assumed mid-2026 rate, not a verified one. The FX observation comes from search-reported RBA figures; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Busan's own local price levels, which sit below Seoul for restaurants and accommodation. Loosely comparable to other large Japanese port and tourist cities such as Fukuoka for everyday dining and cafes.
